title: NSGo game terrain definition (version 1)
description: TerrainDoc is the root of a versioned YAML terrain definition specifying heightmap dimensions, splat (weight) map asset paths, height-blending and triplanar settings, and up to 8 PBR material layers.

version.description: Version is the schema version; must be 1.

name.description: Name is an optional human-readable name for the terrain.

heightmap.description: Heightmap is the asset path to the grayscale heightmap image.

cellSize.description: CellSize is the world-space XZ spacing between adjacent heightmap samples; omitted or 0 defaults to 1.

heightScale.description: HeightScale scales normalized [0, 1] heightmap samples into world-space Y units.

origin.description: Origin is the world-space [x, y, z] origin of heightmap sample (0, 0); omitted defaults to [0, 0, 0].

chunkSize.description: ChunkSize is the number of heightmap grid cells along each terrain LOD chunk edge; omitted or 0 defaults to 64.

splatMaps.description: SplatMaps lists 1 or 2 RGBA weight-map asset paths: map 0 drives layers 0..3 (R,G,B,A) and map 1 drives layers 4..7 (R,G,B,A).

heightBlendContrast.description: HeightBlendContrast enables height-based layer blending when > 0 in [0, 1]; higher values sharpen layer transitions using per-layer height maps, and 0 uses linear splat blending.

triplanar.description: Triplanar configures slope-driven triplanar texture projection on steep terrain faces.

layers.description: Layers lists 1 to 8 PBR terrain material layers in splat-channel order (0..3 from splatMaps[0] RGBA, 4..7 from splatMaps[1] RGBA).

TerrainLayerDoc.description: TerrainLayerDoc describes one PBR terrain material layer in a [TerrainDoc].

name.description: Name is the unique gameplay and authoring identifier for this layer (such as "grass", "dirt", "rock", "snow").

albedo.description: Albedo is the asset path to the sRGB base-color texture.

normal.description: Normal is the asset path to the linear tangent-space normal map.

metallicRoughness.description: MetallicRoughness is the asset path to the glTF metallic-roughness map (G = roughness, B = metallic).

height.description: Height is the asset path to the optional grayscale height map used for height-based blending.

color.description: Color is the linear RGB tint multiplier in [0, 1]^3; omitted defaults to [1, 1, 1].

roughness.description: Roughness is the layer roughness factor in [0, 1]; omitted defaults to 1 when metallicRoughness is set or 0.85 otherwise.

metallic.description: Metallic is the layer metallic factor in [0, 1]; omitted defaults to 0.

normalScale.description: NormalScale scales the XY components of the tangent-space normal map; omitted defaults to 1.

uvScale.description: UVScale is the per-layer UV tiling multiplier [u, v] across the terrain; omitted defaults to [1, 1].

heightBias.description: HeightBias biases this layer's height map during height-based blending in [-1, 1].

TerrainTriplanarDoc.description: TerrainTriplanarDoc configures slope-driven triplanar projection in a [TerrainDoc].

enabled.description: Enabled activates triplanar projection on steep slopes whose upward normal falls below SlopeThreshold.

slopeThreshold.description: SlopeThreshold is the world normal Y threshold in [0, 1] below which triplanar projection begins blending in; omitted or 0 defaults to 0.7.

slopeBlend.description: SlopeBlend is the transition width in [0, 1] over which planar UVs cross-fade into triplanar projection; omitted or 0 defaults to 0.15.

sharpness.description: Sharpness controls triplanar axis blend sharpness (typically 1..16); omitted or 0 defaults to 4.

scale.description: Scale is the world-space triplanar repeat rate (repeats per world unit); omitted or 0 defaults to 0.25.
